summary: Session 1 of 3 remaining-work-planner: Phase 4 gap audit complete. Audited the mechanical-harvester pipeline against the 7 Phase 4 'Done' criteria from docs/planning/strategy.md → Phase 4 (Mechanical Harvester Finish Line). Authored gap-audit.md (in-conversation by Claude Opus 4.7 @ effort=high per the orchestrator-matches-target convention) classifying each criterion: COVERED (#2 schema finality), GAP small or fold-in (#1 canonical-parse-success-report, #4 cli-e2e-test-audit, #5 unresolved-items-report, #6 operations-and-interpretation-docs, #7 cli-packaging), GAP central (#3 canonical-golden-output). All five Frozen-Unless-Reauthorized items from the 2026-05-17 strategic review remain frozen. ai-assignment.md authored in-conversation as well. 6 named gaps total; rough sequencing 6 follow-on session sets over 10-14 sessions at ~$1.00-$1.40 routed cost to close Phase 4. Three open questions for the human surfaced (MiniComplex inclusion, macros/property-sheet boundary, packaging shape) — Session 2 should not start until at least the first two have resolutions. Cross-provider verification with gpt-5-4: round 1 ISSUES_FOUND (1 Major classification-consistency + 2 Minor over-deferral / over-prescription); round 2 ISSUES_FOUND (1 Minor stale-cross-reference introduced by R1 fixes); round 3 VERIFIED clean. Total routed cost $0.337 (over the $0.05-$0.20 spec target by ~70% due to two retry rounds; both findings were legitimate). Calibration note for next session: pre-fix narrative-sweep before re-verification would have caught Round 2's finding at zero cost. Build/test N/A — no code touched in this meta-planning session.

rationale.specifics: Stub-spec authoring against the gap audit benefits from inheriting Session 1's pipeline-state context; an Opus continuation preserves that synthesis without forcing a re-read pass. The work involves drafting ~6 stub specs at acceptance-criteria level (no implementation details, per the R1 Minor #3 anti-coupling lesson) plus a remaining-work-tree.md index. That is the same synthesis-heavy meta-planning shape as Session 1. Switch to Sonnet only if Session 1's gap audit is judged simple enough to stub mechanically — unlikely given the central canonical-golden-output gap's medium-band cost and the need to coordinate it against the per-Phase-4-criterion structure.

next_orchestrator.summary: Session 2 of 3: Plan The Remaining Work. For each of the 6 in-scope GAPs from gap-audit.md, author a stub spec.md at docs/session-sets/<harvester-finish-*>/. Author remaining-work-tree.md as the row-per-set index. Author tree-amendments.md if any gaps fold into existing sets rather than warranting new ones. Pre-req: the human must resolve at least Open Question 1 (MiniComplex inclusion) and Open Question 2 (macros/property-sheet boundary) before Session 2 starts; Open Question 3 (packaging shape) can resolve at stub-authoring step. Honor the Session-1-vs-Session-2 boundary discipline: stubs author at acceptance-criteria level, not implementation prescription.
